name: 02494 · Needham, MA
findings: ZIP 02494 (Needham) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02494 (Needham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02494 (Needham) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02494 (Needham) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
